segments.name: Water Management
products: Professional grade water safety and control products
segments.description: Designs, manufactures, and markets specification-driven water management solutions for institutional, commercial, waterworks and residential construction.
segments.evidence: The Company's product portfolio includes professional grade water safety and control products, flow systems products, hygienic and environmental products and filtered drinking water products.

revenueModel.text: Building owners and construction market participants pay for specification-driven water management products for new construction, retrofit, and waterworks applications.
revenueModel.evidence: The demand for our products is primarily driven by new institutional and commercial building construction, the retrofit of existing structures (to make them more energy and water efficient) and, to a lesser extent, new infrastructure and residential construction.

changes.text: In 2022, the company completed the Elkay Merger and changed its name to Zurn Elkay Water Solutions Corporation.
changes.evidence: On July 1, 2022, the Merger was completed following which we changed our name to "Zurn Elkay Water Solutions Corporation".

changes.text: In 2021, the company divested its Process & Motion Control business to Regal Rexnord Corporation through a Reverse Morris Trust tax-free spin-off transaction.
changes.evidence: On October 4, 2021, we completed a Reverse Morris Trust tax-free spin-off transaction (the "Spin-Off Transaction") in which our former Process & Motion Control business was divested to Regal Rexnord Corporation (formerly known as Regal Beloit Corporation).
